newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DULL SESSION MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DULL SESSION MIXED.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted stable on the U.S. unit and the rand, firmer against pound sterling but easier versus the mark after a dull interbank trading session on Tuesday, dealers said.
"The market was quiet the whole day and I never moved my (exchange) rates. I'd call it a dead market really," one said.
Dealers re-iterated that a three-week strike by doctors and nurses demanding salary hikes and improved working conditions had still not affected the demand/supply-driven market.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 10.6400/6600 against the U.S. currency, where it has been anchored since last Friday and was also steady at 2.2600/2800 against the rand.
It edged up to 17.5100/5300 from Monday's 17.5200/5400 against sterling but was quoted softer on the mark at 7.0900/1100 compared to 7.0700/0900 overnight.
